supplemental_findings.affected_routes: The root guide and its 17 sitemap-emitted framework-scoped variants.
supplemental_findings.finding: The guide presents a copied frontend implementation using a one-argument useJsonParser call and useUiKit({ catalog, value }). Installed 0.5.0-beta.4 types require useJsonParser(json, schema), and useUiKit accepts components plus optional examples and returns a renderer. All five selected Showcase renderers use that installed API.

The page is readable, but it cannot serve as the required exact runnable source reference.
